featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent guidance. I was able to get my new apartment designed with their service. Their professional came to my apartment for measurements and pictures. Based on that they gave me great interior design drawings with details of lightning as well. The end result of my apartment interiors is really too good - everyone keeps asking me who the interior designer is and are surprised when they hear that I used the online services from contractorbhai. The guidance on materials, labour prices etc is also invaluable :)

featured_reviews.name: Megha kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I hired a local interior designer to do work on my new house. Unfortunately we didn't get along and I had to ditch her at the 11th hour. I had worked with contractorbhai in the past for my office interiors and had good experience. So I reached out to them and asked them to give me a quick design. Soon enough they came for measurements and my project was allocated to the talented designer Anuj Sharma. They promised me to get the design done in 1 week and believe you me they did give me a very detailed and through plan for every room witgin deadline. Anuj took care of our expectations and requirements while building the plan to the minutest detail. He was always available for discussion/suggestion not only during design but even during execution phase. I use to take tips from Anuj for negotiating with contractors.
It was a dream project for me and my husband and it has come out so well. Very are so happy we hired them for designing it.  I would any day vouch for contractorbhai and team for their professional work.

featured_reviews.name: Aksh M
featured_reviews.review_text: I approached Contractorbhai for a design for my apartment in Worli, Mumbai. Jatin Rathod visited my home and took detailed measurements and the 3D & 2D designs he and his team delivered were very helpful. The visual illustrations and attention to detail were two steps ahead of other contractors I approached. I then asked Jatin to take on the renovation work as well and he did an excellent job completing it with professionalism and sincerity. As I was living abroad while the work was happening, Jatin took on the work responsibly, honestly and with great communication and patience. I highly recommend Jatin Rathod and Contractorbhai for all home renovation work.

featured_reviews.name: Mukesh Mehlawat
featured_reviews.review_text: I have used the services for the renovation of my house. They have been so helpful with full dedication in the entire execution of the work. Whenever I have asked to provide some alternative to better satisfy me they always do that. I am specially thankful to Mr. Anuj Sharma, Architect for all his new ideas and consistent support to get the work done as per my requirements.

featured_reviews.name: Shailaja Vichare
featured_reviews.review_text: Mr Jatin Rathod prepared 2D and 3D elevation images as per my requirements which helped the my civil conyractor to complete the work without any hassel. It was a good experience to be connected with Contractorbhai for smooth completion of renovation work of my home.

featured_reviews.name: sharath babu kalikota
featured_reviews.review_text: When I was planning to renovate my house, I have no idea on apt Color combination, tiles selection, aesthetics and ergonomics… I was searching for a service who can provide me a basic idea on all these aspects. Then I have approached Contractorbhai. Though the charge to just give a 3d drawing is high, but the detailing like electric points correction, tile size, brand selection with codes, curtain design and overall look how your house will be after renovation will be forming a base idea upon which your can add your own creativity. The total budget for me doubled than my initial estimation. But everyone one who visited my house just said one thing…. “It’s like a star hotel” . So I can conclude that it’s worth taking the service from them. Adding to that they don’t do any marketing for any product they suggested in their design.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently availed the services of Sikander Plumbing Services and was thoroughly impressed with the quality of work delivered. The team handled the installation of my washroom fixtures, water purifier, and washing machine with exceptional precision and professionalism.

From the outset, it was clear that the plumber was highly skilled and knowledgeable, requiring no continuous supervision. The use of appropriate tools and meticulous attention to detail ensured that the installations were done correctly, leaving no room for complaints.

The work was executed efficiently and without any sloppiness, reflecting the high standards of Sikander Plumbing Services. The plumber's expertise and dedication to the job were evident throughout the process.

I would highly recommend Sikander Plumbing Services to anyone in need of reliable and top-notch plumbing solutions. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is truly commendable.
